name: origin-cline-sidecar
description: Sidecar Node exposant le moteur d'agent Cline SDK (Origin) via un protocole NDJSON sur stdin/stdout.

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outfile=dist/index.mjs --minify --legal-comments=none --banner:js="import { createRequire as __originCreateRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __originCreateRequire(import.meta.url);"
